verses.original: Ἀρχὴ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Archē tou euangeliou Iēsou Christou Huiou tou Theou
verses.literal: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ the Son of God

verses.original: Καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ Ἠσαΐᾳ τῷ προφήτῃ Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου
verses.transliteration: Kathōs gegraptai en tō Ēsaia tō prophētē Idou apostellō ton angelon mou pro prosōpou sou hos kataskeuasei tēn hodon sou
verses.literal: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet Behold I will send My messenger ahead of You . . . . . . who will prepare Your way

verses.original: Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō Hetoimasate tēn hodon Kyriou eutheias poieite tas tribous autou
verses.literal: A voice of one calling in the wilderness Prepare the way for the Lord make straight paths for Him

verses.original: Ἐγένετο Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: Egeneto Iōannēs ho baptizōn en tē erēmō kai kēryssōn baptisma metanoias eis aphesin hamartiōn
verses.literal: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins

verses.original: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία χώρα καὶ οἱ Ἱεροσολυμῖται πάντες καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai exeporeueto pros auton pasa hē Ioudaia chōra kai hoi Hierosolymitai pantes kai ebaptizonto hyp’ autou en tō Iordanē potamō exomologoumenoi tas hamartias autōn
verses.literal: People went out to him . . . from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea Confessing their sins they were baptized by him in the Jordan River

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν ὁ Ἰωάννης ἐνδεδυμένος τρίχας καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσθων ἀκρίδας καὶ μέλι ἄγριον
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn ho Iōannēs endedymenos trichas kamēlou kai zōnēn dermatinēn peri tēn osphyn autou kai esthōn akridas kai meli agrion
verses.literal: John was clothed in camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist His food was locusts and wild honey

verses.original: καὶ ἐκήρυσσεν λέγων Ἔρχεται ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου ὀπίσω μου οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς κύψας λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ekēryssen legōn Erchetai ho ischyroteros mou opisō mou hou ouk eimi hikanos kypsas lysai ton himanta tōn hypodēmatōn autou
verses.literal: And he proclaimed . . . After me will come One more powerful than I the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐβάπτισα ὑμᾶς ὕδατι αὐτὸς δὲ βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: egō ebaptisa hymas hydati autos de baptisei hymas en Pneumati Hagiō
verses.literal: I baptize you with water but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲτ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη εἰς τὸν Ἰορδάνην ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en ekeinais tais hēmerais ēlthen Iēsous apo Nazaret tēs Galilaias kai ebaptisthē eis ton Iordanēn hypo Iōannou
verses.literal: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος εἶδεν σχιζομένους τοὺς οὐρανοὺς καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα ὡς περιστερὰν καταβαῖνον εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai euthys anabainōn ek tou hydatos eiden schizomenous tous ouranous kai to Pneuma hōs peristeran katabainon eis auton
verses.literal: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove

verses.original: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα
verses.transliteration: kai phōnē egeneto ek tōn ouranōn Sy ei ho Huios mou ho agapētos en soi eudokēsa
verses.literal: And a voice came from heaven You are My beloved Son in You I am well pleased

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς τὸ Πνεῦμα αὐτὸν ἐκβάλλει εἰς τὴν ἔρημον
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys to Pneuma auton ekballei eis tēn erēmon
verses.literal: At once the Spirit drove Jesus . . . into the wilderness

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ καὶ ἦν μετὰ τῶν θηρίων καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι διηκόνουν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ēn en tē erēmō tesserakonta hēmeras peirazomenos hypo tou Satana kai ēn meta tōn thēriōn kai hoi angeloi diēkonoun autō
verses.literal: and He was there for forty days being tempted by Satan He was with the wild animals and the angels ministered to Him

verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ τὸ παραδοθῆναι τὸν Ἰωάννην ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai meta to paradothēnai ton Iōannēn ēlthen ho Iēsous eis tēn Galilaian kēryssōn to euangelion tou Theou
verses.literal: After the arrest of John Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God

verses.original: καὶ λέγων ὅτι Πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ
verses.transliteration: kai legōn hoti Peplērōtai ho kairos kai ēngiken hē basileia tou Theou metanoeite kai pisteuete en tō euangeliō
verses.literal: The time is fulfilled He said and the kingdom of God is near Repent and believe in the gospel

verses.original: Καὶ παράγων παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν Σίμωνα καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν Σίμωνος ἀμφιβάλλοντας ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλιεῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai paragōn para tēn thalassan tēs Galilaias eiden Simōna kai Andrean ton adelphon Simōnos amphiballontas en tē thalassē ēsan gar halieis
verses.literal: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee He saw Simon and his brother Andrew They were casting a net into the sea for they were fishermen

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς γενέσθαι ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autois ho Iēsous Deute opisō mou kai poiēsō hymas genesthai halieis anthrōpōn
verses.literal: Come, follow . . . Me - Jesus said . . . and I will make you fishers of men

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai euthys aphentes ta diktya ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: And at once they left their nets and followed Him

verses.original: Καὶ προβὰς ὀλίγον εἶδεν Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα
verses.transliteration: Kai probas oligon eiden Iakōbon ton tou Zebedaiou kai Iōannēn ton adelphon autou kai autous en tō ploiō katartizontas ta diktya
verses.literal: Going on a little farther He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John They were in a boat mending their nets

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν Ζεβεδαῖον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ τῶν μισθωτῶν ἀπῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai euthys ekalesen autous kai aphentes ton patera autōn Zebedaion en tō ploiō meta tōn misthōtōn apēlthon opisō autou
verses.literal: Immediately Jesus called them and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed . . . Him

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσπορεύονται εἰς Καφαρναούμ καὶ εὐθὺς τοῖς σάββασιν εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐδίδασκεν
verses.transliteration: Kai eisporeuontai eis Kapharnaoum kai euthys tois sabbasin eiselthōn eis tēn synagōgēn edidasken
verses.literal: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum and right away Jesus entered . . . the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach

verses.original: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ ἦν γὰρ διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐξουσίαν ἔχων καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς
verses.transliteration: kai exeplēssonto epi tē didachē autou ēn gar didaskōn autous hōs exousian echōn kai ouch hōs hoi grammateis
verses.literal: The people were astonished at His teaching because He taught as one who had authority and not as the scribes

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἦν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπος ἐν πνεύματι ἀκαθάρτῳ καὶ ἀνέκραξεν
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys ēn en tē synagōgē autōn anthrōpos en pneumati akathartō kai anekraxen
verses.literal: Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue

verses.original: λέγων Τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς οἶδά σε τίς εἶ ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: legōn Ti hēmin kai soi Iēsou Nazarēne ēlthes apolesai hēmas oida se tis ei ho Hagios tou Theou
verses.literal: What do You want with us Jesus of Nazareth Have You come to destroy us I know who You are the Holy One of God

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai epetimēsen autō ho Iēsous legōn Phimōthēti kai exelthe ex autou
verses.literal: But Jesus rebuked the spirit Be silent He said Come out of him

verses.original: καὶ σπαράξαν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον καὶ φωνῆσαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai sparaxan auton to pneuma to akatharton kai phōnēsan phōnē megalē exēlthen ex autou
verses.literal: At this the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions . . . and came out - with a loud shriek . . .

verses.original: Καὶ ἐθαμβήθησαν ἅπαντες ὥστε συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντας Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο διδαχὴ καινή κατ’ ἐξουσίαν καὶ τοῖς πνεύμασι τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις ἐπιτάσσει καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai ethambēthēsan hapantes hōste syzētein pros heautous legontas Ti estin touto didachē kainē kat’ exousian kai tois pneumasi tois akathartois epitassei kai hypakouousin autō
verses.literal: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another What is this A new teaching with authority He commands even the unclean spirits and they obey Him

verses.original: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εὐθὺς πανταχοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον τῆς Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: kai exēlthen hē akoē autou euthys pantachou eis holēn tēn perichōron tēs Galilaias
verses.literal: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through . . . the whole region of Galilee

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐξελθόντες ἦλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys ek tēs synagōgēs exelthontes ēlthon eis tēn oikian Simōnos kai Andreou meta Iakōbou kai Iōannou
verses.literal: As soon as . . . Jesus and His companions had left . . . the synagogue they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew

verses.original: ἡ δὲ πενθερὰ Σίμωνος κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα καὶ εὐθὺς λέγουσιν αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: hē de penthera Simōnos katekeito pyressousa kai euthys legousin autō peri autēs
verses.literal: Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever and they promptly told . . . Jesus about her

verses.original: καὶ προσελθὼν ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai proselthōn ēgeiren autēn kratēsas tēs cheiros kai aphēken autēn ho pyretos kai diēkonei autois
verses.literal: So He went to her took her by the hand and helped her up . . . The fever left her and she began to serve them

verses.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ὅτε ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους
verses.transliteration: Opsias de genomenēs hote edy ho hēlios epheron pros auton pantas tous kakōs echontas kai tous daimonizomenous
verses.literal: That evening . . . after sunset . . . people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ὅλη ἡ πόλις ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν
verses.transliteration: kai ēn holē hē polis episynēgmenē pros tēn thyran
verses.literal: and the whole town gathered at the door

verses.original: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλεν καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν λαλεῖν τὰ δαιμόνια ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai etherapeusen pollous kakōs echontas poikilais nosois kai daimonia polla exebalen kai ouk ēphien lalein ta daimonia hoti ēdeisan auton
verses.literal: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons But He would not allow the demons to speak because they knew who He was

verses.original: Καὶ πρωῒ ἔννυχα λίαν ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κἀκεῖ προσηύχετο
verses.transliteration: Kai prōi ennycha lian anastas exēlthen kai apēlthen eis erēmon topon kakei prosēucheto
verses.literal: Early in the morning while it was still dark Jesus got up and went out . . . . . . to a solitary place . . . to pray

verses.original: καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν Σίμων καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai katediōxen auton Simōn kai hoi met’ autou
verses.literal: Simon and his companions . . . . . . went to look for Him

verses.original: καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πάντες ζητοῦσίν σε
verses.transliteration: kai heuron auton kai legousin autō hoti Pantes zētousin se
verses.literal: and when they found Him they said . . . Everyone is looking for You

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἄγωμεν ἀλλαχοῦ εἰς τὰς ἐχομένας κωμοπόλεις ἵνα καὶ ἐκεῖ κηρύξω εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐξῆλθον
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autois Agōmen allachou eis tas echomenas kōmopoleis hina kai ekei kēryxō eis touto gar exēlthon
verses.literal: But Jesus answered . . . Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well for that is why . . . I have come

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθεν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν εἰς ὅλην τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλων
verses.transliteration: kai ēlthen kēryssōn eis tas synagōgas autōn eis holēn tēn Galilaian kai ta daimonia ekballōn
verses.literal: So He went throughout . . . Galilee preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λεπρὸς παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ γονυπετῶν καὶ λέγων αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι
verses.transliteration: Kai erchetai pros auton lepros parakalōn auton kai gonypetōn kai legōn autō hoti Ean thelēs dynasai me katharisai
verses.literal: Then a leper came to Jesus begging on his knees - - If You are willing You can make me clean . . .

verses.original: Καὶ σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἥψατο καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Θέλω καθαρίσθητι
verses.transliteration: Kai splanchnistheis ekteinas tēn cheira autou hēpsato kai legei autō Thelō katharisthēti
verses.literal: Moved with compassion Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man I am willing He said Be clean

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθη
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys apēlthen ap’ autou hē lepra kai ekatharisthē
verses.literal: And immediately the leprosy left . . . him and the man was cleansed

verses.original: Καὶ ἐμβριμησάμενος αὐτῷ εὐθὺς ἐξέβαλεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai embrimēsamenos autō euthys exebalen auton
verses.literal: Jesus promptly sent him away . . . with a stern warning . . .

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὅρα μηδενὶ μηδὲν εἴπῃς ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκε περὶ τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ σου ἃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai legei autō Hora mēdeni mēden eipēs alla hypage seauton deixon tō hierei kai prosenenke peri tou katharismou sou ha prosetaxen Mōusēs eis martyrion autois
verses.literal: - See that you don’t tell . . . anyone But go show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing as a testimony to them

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐξελθὼν ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν πολλὰ καὶ διαφημίζειν τὸν λόγον ὥστε μηκέτι αὐτὸν δύνασθαι φανερῶς εἰς πόλιν εἰσελθεῖν ἀλλ’ ἔξω ἐπ’ ἐρήμοις τόποις ἦν καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντοθεν
verses.transliteration: Ho de exelthōn ērxato kēryssein polla kai diaphēmizein ton logon hōste mēketi auton dynasthai phanerōs eis polin eiselthein all’ exō ep’ erēmois topois ēn kai ērchonto pros auton pantothen
verses.literal: But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news Consequently Jesus could no longer . . . enter . . . a town in plain view but He stayed out in solitary places Yet people came to Him from every quarter
